Game Overview

In Block Sniper, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Block Sniper follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Block Sniper?

Block Sniper is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Block Sniper free to play?

Yes, Block Sniper is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
